text.config.enchantmentdisabler-config.o:
Removes enchantments defined in the list below from gameplay.
An example entry is provided.

Limit the enchantment level of specified enchantments to specified values.
Add new entries below in the following format:
[enchantment]/[maxLevel].
An example entry is provided.
Modify Max Enchanted Book Trade Uses

Set the maximum amount of times enchanted book trades
can be used before having to restock.
Vanilla is 12.
Modify Max Enchanted Item Trade Uses

Set the maximum amount of times enchanted item trades
can be used before having to restock.
Vanilla is 3.
Set to Disabled to make enchanted book trades never restock.
Set to Disabled to make enchanted item trades never restock.

Set to Disabled to completely disable the function of the enchanting table.
Using it will do nothing.
You'll still be able to get the Enchanter advancement
by enchanting any item in the anvil.

Change the maximum amount of bookshelves that
the enchanting table can accept to increase
its enchanting power.

Change the amount of lapis required to enchant items,
where 'id' is the index of the given enchantment option:
id = 0 -> option 1
id = 1 -> option 2
id = 2 -> option 3
Must have id in the formula. Results 0 and below will be corrected to 1.
Vanilla formula is 'id+1'

Change the amount of XP levels required to enchant items,
where 'id' is the index of the given enchantment option:
id = 0 -> option 1
id = 1 -> option 2
id = 2 -> option 3
Must have id in the formula. Results 0 and below will be corrected to 1.
Vanilla formula is 'id+1'

Changes Protection to only work against physical damage
and renames it to Melee Protection.

Changes Fire Protection to work against lightning and freeze damage
on top of fire damage and renames it to Elemental Protection.
Adds a new armor enchantment that protects against magic damage.
Makes Feather Falling mutually exclusive with other protection enchantments.
Allows multiple different types of protection enchantments on the same item.
Set the maximum allowed amount of different protection types on the same item.

Set a limit on how strong enchantments can be on looted equipment.
For reference, the enchanting table has a limit of 30.
Vanilla looted equipment limit can go up to 50 in some places.
